name: Explicit 4D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A keyframe interpolation-based 4D Gaussian splatting method that works in a fully explicit on-time domain by separating static and dynamic Gaussians and explicitly sampling positions and rotations at sparse timestamps.
summary: Explicit 4D Gaussian Splatting is a dynamic novel view synthesis method that achieves memory efficiency by separating scene primitives into static and dynamic categories and explicitly interpolating their attributes over time.
